h1: The 5 Best Desk Cup Holders of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Desk Cup Holders 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five clamp-on and clip-on desk cup holders, including OOKUU, GUNKING and a 360 degree swivel model, all under $25.
summary: The OOKUU Large Desk Cup Holder Clamp is our pick for oversized tumblers, thanks to its metal clamp and deep cavity. The 360 degree rotating model swings out of the way, GUNKING adds a headphone hanger, HzTinT is the simple clip-on, and one listing discloses a 3.9 inch cavity.
intro: The mistake with desk cup holders is buying for the clamp and ignoring the cup. A holder that grips your desk but is too narrow for your tumbler ends up a very small shelf.

We reviewed five holders, all in the under $25 bucket, and ranked them on build material, attachment style and what they hold. Listings give few hard numbers, so check the cup diameter against your own bottle before buying.

products.name: OOKUU Upgraded Large Desk Cup Holder Clamp, Anti-Spill
products.verdict: A sturdy metal clamp with a deep cavity for big tumblers.
products.description:
The OOKUU Large Desk Cup Holder Clamp uses a large-diameter metal clamp and a deep, form-fitting cavity, and attaches without drilling. It is in the under $25 bucket.

First place goes to the combination of metal build and depth for oversized drinks; the plastic holder below gives up that sturdiness.

Buy it if you carry big tumblers. Exact cup diameter is not in our facts, so check it.

products.name: 360° Rotating Desk Cup Holder, Anti-Spill Metal Cup Holder
products.verdict: A metal holder that swings away when you are not using it.
products.description:
This holder has a 360 degree rotating clamp base, metal construction and a no-drill attachment, and it fits a standard cup diameter. It is in the under $25 bucket.

Second place is because it fits only standard-diameter cups, unlike the OOKUU's oversized capacity. The swing-out base is its advantage.

Buy it for a tight desk where space matters. Big tumblers will not fit.
products.idealFor: Tight desks where the holder must move aside.

products.name: GUNKING Luxury 2-in-1 Anti-Spill Cup Holder with Headphone Hanger
products.verdict: One clamp that holds your drink and your headphones.
products.description:
The GUNKING 2-in-1 combines a cup well and a built-in headphone hook on one clamp, finished in white, in the under $25 bucket.

Third place is because the added hanger means a different job from the pure cup holders above. It saves desk space for two items.

Buy it if headphones also need a home. Check the cup size on the listing.
products.idealFor: Headphone users who want fewer desk accessories.
products.skipIf: You only need a cup holder.

products.name: HzTinT Large Desk Cup Holder, Fully Covered Anti-Spill Clip-On
products.verdict: A compact fully covered clip-on at the lowest price.
products.description:
The HzTinT has a fully covered cavity, clip-on attachment and a compact footprint, in the under $25 bucket and listed as the lowest price here.

Fourth place is since a clip-on is a lighter attachment than the clamp styles above. Its cost and size are the draw.

Buy it for a simple, light-duty holder. Heavy tumblers are not what it is built for.

products.name: Large Clamp On Cup Holder for Desk, 3.9" Diameter
products.verdict: The only one that states its cavity diameter: 3.9 inches.
products.description:
This clamp-on holder discloses a 3.9 inch cavity diameter, attaches without drilling and has a compact footprint, in the under $25 bucket.

It ranks fifth because it has fewer extras than the others, but disclosing the size takes the guesswork out.

Buy it if you want to check fit before you click. Verify your cup against 3.9 inches.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want to confirm cup fit first.
products.skipIf: You want extras like a hanger.

whatMatters.detail: Diameter is the width of the cavity. It matters because a tumbler wider than the cavity does not fit at all. Look for the diameter in the listing, like the 3.9 inches on one pick, and measure your cup.
Clamps grip the desk edge, while clips hang lighter. It matters for heavy drinks. Look for metal clamp wording for large cups.
Metal resists flex, plastic is lighter. It matters for tipping. Check the material in the title or bullets.
Clamps only fit certain edge thicknesses. It matters because a thick desk can block the clamp. Check the clamp range on the listing, which our facts do not list.
Features like a headphone hanger add use. It matters on a crowded desk. Look for them by name in the listing.
